title: Dimensions for swivel type coupling to dental handpieces
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12374) covers Dimensions for swivel type coupling to dental handpieces. This Indian Standard, which is Identical with ISO 3964-1982 'Dental handpieces — Coupling dimensions' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), was adopted by the Committee and approval of the Consumer Products and Medical Instruments Division Council. In the adopted standard, certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards, attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Comma ( , ) has been used as decimal marker, while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. b) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, these should be read as 'Indian Standard'. Dimensions for slip-joint coupling for dental handpieces are covered in 18:5830-1970 'Dimensions for transmission coupling (slip-joint) to dental handpieces'. Adopted 28 December 1987 O September 1988, BIS Gr 2 As in the Original Standard, this Page is Intentionally Left Blank IS : 1237
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions for swivel type coupling to dental handpieces

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
